item.description:

Each writer was a resident, worker or student in Napa County. Writers submitted one or two unpublished stories in either prose or poetry format, with a limit of 60 words per story. A winning story connected all elements together, showing creativity and originality!
Submissions were accepted in English from adults or youth age 18 or younger, or in Spanish from youth age 18 or younger.

item.title: Phil Johnson: Overthought Comedy and Underthought Songs — Thu Sep 24, 7:00 PM — Main Street Theater
item.description:
Phil Johnson has been doing standup since 2004 and writing songs since 1993, and the show is both. People often describe the part where the guitar comes out as a second show they didn't have to pay for.
The current show is about the dudes who watch conspiracy videos for "funzies," America's refusal to learn the metric system, forty acres and a mule and what that means for Target, and what it's like to be a vacuum dad.
He's done this before. Four comedy specials, several albums and singles, plus runs at Sundance and the Edinburgh Fringe and appearances on SiriusXM, Bob and Tom Radio, and Amazon Prime.
90 minutes, all laughs, and songs you'll still be singing the next day against your will.
Main Street Theater, 104 N. Main St., Sebastopol. Doors 6:30pm, show 7pm. $25 advance, $30 at the door if there are any left. Just fifty-nine seats.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.title: Hardly Strictly Irish Harvest Moon Concert — Sat Sep 26, 5:00 PM — St. Stephen's Sanctuary
item.description:
**Hardly Strictly Irish Harvest Moon Concert in Sebastopol**
September 26, 2026
Concert 5:00-6:30 p.m. | Potluck 6:30-7:30 p.m.
Enjoy a magical evening of live, **traditional Irish and Roots-Americana music and Irish dance**, and a potluck to celebrate the Harvest Moon in Sebastopol, California on Saturday, Sept. 26 at 5pm.
**HARDLY STRICTLY IRISH** (Suzuki Cady and Jimmy Murphy) bring an uplifting, warm, and soulful energy, and a signature blend of traditional Irish tunes and Appalachian, country-folk, and roots-Americana songs. Their rich sound features the fiddle, mandolin, guitar, banjo, bodhrán, and vocal harmonies.
**Shiloh Step Irish Dance of Santa Rosa** will perform at intermission and will teach a Ceili (group dance) during the potluck after-party. Bring a potluck dish (optional) to share after the show in honor of the Harvest Moon!

item.title: Copperfield's Books Presents Kristin Hannah, In Conversation — Sat Sep 26, 7:30 PM — Luther Burbank Center for the Arts
item.description:
Kristin Hannah, author of The Nightingale and The Four Winds, comes to the LBC on Saturday, September 26, for a conversation about her newest release, The Women, at once an intimate portrait of coming of age in a dangerous time and an epic tale of a nation divided. Set in 1965, it is a novel about deep friendships and bold patriotism, a richly drawn story with a memorable heroine whose idealism and courage under fire will come to define an era. Join us for this warmhearted reading and conversation followed by a live audience Q&A. Presented by Copperfield's Books, every ticket includes a pre-signed paperback copy of the book, The Women. Photos and video are strictly prohibited for this event
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.title: Modern Love: The David Bowie Experience — Sat Sep 26, 7:30 PM — The California
item.description: MODERN LOVE - The David Bowie Experience is a high-energy, authentic DAVID BOWIE tribute to one of the most innovative and influential artists of all time. With meticulous attention to detail, MODERN LOVE recreates the music, the style, and the charisma that made David Bowie a global icon. MODERN LOVE takes audiences on a journey through the eclectic catalog of Bowie's legendary career, bringing a balance between theatrical flair and genuine musicianship, pulling the crowd into Bowie's ever-evolving universe. Front man Damon Taylor Frick delivers a performance that's remarkably true to Bowie - he doesn't just sing Bowie's songs- he understands them. His vocals carry that familiar Bowie tone and phrasing and he comfortably inhabits the material, vocally, visually, and in spirit - Modern Love is an experience that will leave you in awe. item.title: Culinary Garden Cooking Classes at Quivira Vineyards — Sun Sep 27, 12:00 AM — Quivira Vineyards and Winery
item.description:
Join an immersive, hands-on culinary series at Quivira Vineyards, offered June 7-November 15 from 11 AM - 2 PM. Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Sunset hike at Taylor mountain regional park — Sun Sep 27, 5:00 PM
item.description:
North Bay's 20s and 30s social adventurers Start your week off right and join us for an enchanting evening at Taylor Mountain Regional Park as we embark on a Sunset Hike! Witness the breathtaking transition from day to dusk while exploring the scenic trails and basking in the warm hues of the setting sun. Enjoy an opportunity to connect with nature, unwind, and share the beauty of a sunset with like-minded individuals.
Whether you're a seasoned hiker or just seeking a peaceful escape, this event promises a memorable experience. Don't forget to bring your comfortable hiking gear, a water bottle, and a camera to capture the stunning sunset moments.
This will be a roughly 4 mile hike. There are many spots along the way up the hill to view the sunset but the goal will be to make it to the top via the western route starting from the disk golf area.
